blocks.html: Chances are, you’ve found yourself hooked on TikTok, the leading short-form mobile video platform where you can find all sorts of trending clips—from LSS-inducing dance crazes and funny lip-synched lines to hilarious challenges, educational content and hacks you never thought existed. Or you might also be a budding TikTok creator, sharing your own videos on the platform, discovering new trends, and playing around with the many cool effects, filters, and fun audio clips available to make your content stand out from the pack.

If you’re looking for a great backdrop for your next upload on TikTok, check out Robinsons Place Manila’s Tuloy Pa Rin Ang Pasko TikTok booth! You can find it at the Level 2, Midtown wing until December 31, 2021.

The Tuloy Pa Rin Ang Pasko TikTok booth at Robinsons Place Manila makes for a cool and visually striking setting for all your photos and videos. The Christmas-inspired booth has two fully decorated spots so you can really take your TikTok content to the next level. One side of the Tuloy Pa Rin Ang Pasko TikTok booth is decorated with shiny, colorful Christmas balls, while the other side features a bright LED light shaped like a Christmas tree! If you’re looking for some inspo for your content, you can watch #TuloyPaRinAngPasko TikTok videos on the huge TV display at the booth, too.

And to make it even more exciting, Robinsons Place Manila is inviting you to join their #TuloyPaRinAngPasko hashtag challenge! Drop by the Tuloy Pa Rin Ang Pasko TikTok booth and create your TikTok content using Ben&Ben’s rendition of the song “Tuloy Na Tuloy Pa Rin Ang Pasko.”
Don’t forget to include the hashtag #TuloyPaRinAngPasko when you upload your clip and follow Robinsons Malls (@robinsonsmalls) on TikTok.
Make sure to flex those TikTok skills because the five (5) most creative TikTok content entries will get Robinsons Gift Certificates worth PHP 2,000 and four (4) Robinsons Movieworld passes.

The #TuloyPaRinAngPasko hashtag challenge will run from December 14 to December 31, 2021. Announcement of winners is on January 7, 2022. For more information, visit www.robinsonsmalls.com or follow RobPlaceManila on Facebook; @RobinsonsMallsOfficial on Instagram; and @RobinsonsMalls on Twitter
